title: One far wall is invisible at even sides
claim: Pre-registered 2026-11-10, before the proof attempt. Doubled coordinates of FULL-REACH-PROOF-20261108-001A: contacts are the points (X, Y) with X + Y odd; an h (X odd) reads (X +- 1, Y +- 1) with equal signs, a v (X even) reads (X +- 1, Y -+ 1); reads leaving the region die; A[c, d] = 1 when c reads d, over GF(2). The box is [0, N]^2, N = 2n - 2; the quadrant is [0, oo)^2; the half-strips are [0, N] x [0, oo) and [0, oo) x [0, N]. The corner contact is c = (0, 1), and r(w) = sum_k A^k[c, c] w^k its return series. C(z) = sum_j z^(2^j - 1) is the Catalan series mod 2 and L(z) = z + z^2 + z^4 + ... + z^n the trace polynomial of GF(2n). Target B1: at every even n >= 2 the corner's return series in either half-strip equals the quadrant's, C(w^4), over GF(2). Target B2: at every odd n >= 3 they differ, first at time 4n. Found before registration (computed, this thread): B1 below w^1200 at the even sides 2 to 38 and below w^700 at 2 to 20; B2 at the odd sides 3 to 21 (first difference at 4n) and some difference below w^1200 at every odd side 3 to 39. The two half-strips have the same return series at every side (the diagonal reflection carries one to the other with A to its transpose, and the corner's return series is the same read from (0, 1) or (1, 0)).
failure_conditions: An even side at which a half-strip's corner return series is not C(w^4) (computed false below w^1200 at 2 to 38).
An odd side at which the half-strip and the quadrant agree before time 4n or at 4n (computed false at 3 to 21).
remaining_obligations: B1 by proof for every even n, or the lemma that would finish it, checked exactly at the even sides 2 to 40
B2 by proof or as a computed law
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38), its walk over GF(2), and the same walk with one or both far walls removed. Returns are a contact-level reading, so they do not depend on how the rings are declared beyond which contacts each ring holds (A45).
